environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.xlarge, Amazon Linux 2) running the legacy Java/Python monolith directly on the host OS. The application runs as the 'deploy' user which has write access to /app/deployments and also has write permissions to /etc/cron.d, /opt/monolith/config, and other sensitive directories via group membership in 'ops'. No containerization, no mandatory access control (SELinux in permissive mode). The artifact upload endpoint is exposed on port 8080 behind a basic nginx reverse proxy with no path filtering.

config.network: VPC private subnet with ALB ingress on port 8080
